QuestInfo.name: Lucas' Reply
QuestInfo.parent: Please bring this letter to Lucas
QuestInfo.1: You delivered Maria's letter to Lucas who was in Amherst. He wrote her a reply, which you should bring to Maria.
QuestInfo.2: Maria looked relieved after reading the reply from Lucas. Now you want to read it, too. Wonder what this was all about...

0.0: Ohhh, the letter from #p2103#! I was beginning to worry. Okay, here's the #breply letter#k. Head back to #p2103# and deliver it. Thanks.

no.0: Oh... Are you really busy? Sigh. This letter needs to be delivered right away...

1.0: Oh, the reply letter! Thank you! I want to give you something to show my appreciation.

yes.0: Ta da! A hat! It has a level limitation, but I think you're strong enough to wear it. Thanks again for all your help!
yes.1: To equip items, press the #bI key#k to open the Item Inventory, and then click on #bEquip#k. You can also switch between the different windows by pressing the #bTab#k button. To equip an item, simply #bdouble-click#k on the desired item. To check whether an item has been equipped, press the #bE#k key.

npc.0: You didn't deliver my reply to #r#p2103##k yet? If you lose my reply, just tell me. I suppose I can write up another one.

item.0: Have you not gone to the Chief yet? Or did you lose the letter? Please deliver the letter soon and bring back Chief #b#p12000##'s reply.

lost.0: You lost my reply letter? Bah, such carelessness! I have a town to run, you know. But fine, I'll rewrite the letter. Here, take it, and don't lose it this time.
